working_definition: Remainder of the 'Clock neurons' cluster (Davie et al. 2018, res-2.0 cluster 36; 389 cells) after Pdf-positive LNv cells were pulled out via neuropeptide re-clustering (reported separately as 'LNv'). Confirmed by core clock genes (tim, Clk, cry, vri); most likely an unresolved mix of LNd, DN2, DN3 and/or LPN clock neurons (and possibly residual DN1 cells not captured by the separately-clustered DN1 group), with somata in dorsal/lateral protocerebrum. Not resolved to any single named clock-neuron subgroup.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Pacemaker neuron that is part of the adult nervous system.

justification: FBbt:00006048 'pacemaker neuron' (parent of FBbt:00100163) defines the class by exactly the criterion used to identify this cluster: molecular oscillation of Period/Timeless expression that supports diurnal-rhythm control - matching the tim/Clk/cry/vri marker signature and 'circadian pacemaker neuron' function described in the report. FBbt:00100163 restricts this to the adult nervous system, matching the confirmed adult tissue. The remainder cluster is explicitly a class-level mixture of several named clock-neuron subgroups (LNd, DN2, DN3, LPN) with no further transcriptomic separation, so per dataset guidance for remainder labels the class-level pacemaker-neuron term is the correct (honest) mapping level, not any single subgroup. Confidence is medium rather than high because 'pacemaker neuron' is a functional/molecular class definition rather than a dedicated 'circadian clock neuron of adult brain' anatomy term, and because DN1 residual contamination cannot be ruled out.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Lateral period-expressing neuron (LN) of the adult brain whose cell body is located in the dorsal-most cluster of LNs; six per hemisphere; evening cells.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Too specific: the report explicitly states the remainder cluster likely mixes LNd with DN2, DN3 and/or LPN (and possibly residual DN1), so assigning LNd alone would overstate the resolution achieved.

recommendation: Accept adult pacemaker neuron (FBbt:00100163) as the class-level mapping for this unresolved non-LNv, non-DN1 clock-neuron remainder; do not assign any single named clock subgroup (LNd/DN2/DN3/LPN).
